title: Grammar Hook: Tenses
body: Imagine texting your friend: 'I am eating pizza yesterday.' Your friend would be very confused! The tense you choose tells your reader WHEN the action happened — past, present, or future.
body_hi: कल्पना करें कि आप अपने दोस्त को टेक्स्ट करते हैं: 'मैं कल पिज्जा खा रहा हूं।' आपका दोस्त बहुत भ्रमित होगा! आप जो काल चुनते हैं वह आपके पाठक को बताता है कि क्रिया कब हुई — भूत, वर्तमान या भविष्य।
body_gu: કલ્પના કરો તમે મિત્રને ટેક્સ્ટ કરો: 'હું ગઈ કાલ પિઝ્ઝા ખાઈ રહ્યો છું.' — આ ખોટું છે! કાળ (Tense) ક્રિયા ક્યારે ઘટી તે બતાવે.

question: Before we study Tenses, can you try to identify the error in this sentence: 'She go to school every day'?
question_hi: काल (Tenses) सीखने से पहले, क्या आप इस वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचान सकते हैं?
explanation: Think about it! This is exactly what Tenses helps us fix. Let us discover the rules together.
explanation_hi: यही काल (Tenses) सही करने में मदद करता है।

title: Discover: Tenses in Real Life
body: Look around you — Tenses appears in every English text you read, every exam you write, every email you send. Mastering Tenses = mastering English communication.
body_hi: काल (Tenses) हर अंग्रेजी पाठ में, हर परीक्षा में, हर ईमेल में दिखाई देता है। काल (Tenses) में महारत = अंग्रेजी संचार में महारत।
body_gu: કાળ (Tenses) — everywhere in English. Master it = master English.

title: The 12 Tenses at a Glance
body:
English has 3 time frames × 4 aspects = 12 tenses.

PRESENT: Simple (I eat), Continuous (I am eating), Perfect (I have eaten), Perfect Continuous (I have been eating)

PAST: Simple (I ate), Continuous (I was eating), Perfect (I had eaten), Perfect Continuous (I had been eating)

FUTURE: Simple (I will eat), Continuous (I will be eating), Perfect (I will have eaten), Perfect Continuous (I will have been eating)
body_hi:
अंग्रेजी में 3 समय × 4 पहलू = 12 काल हैं।

वर्तमान: सरल (मैं खाता हूं), सतत (मैं खा रहा हूं), परफेक्ट (मैंने खाया है), परफेक्ट सतत (मैं खाता रहा हूं)

भूत: सरल (मैंने खाया), सतत (मैं खा रहा था), परफेक्ट (मैंने खाया था), परफेक्ट सतत (मैं खाता रहा था)

भविष्य: सरल (मैं खाऊंगा), सतत (मैं खा रहा होऊंगा), परफेक्ट (मैंने खाया होगा), परफेक्ट सतत (मैं खाता रहा होऊंगा)
body_gu:
અંગ્રેજીમાં 3 સમય × 4 પ્રકાર = 12 કાળ.

વર્તમાન: સ. (I eat), સ.ચ. (I am eating), પ. (I have eaten), પ.ચ. (I have been eating)

ભૂત: સ. (I ate), સ.ચ. (I was eating), પ. (I had eaten), પ.ચ. (I had been eating)

ભવિષ્ય: સ. (I will eat), સ.ચ. (I will be eating), પ. (I will have eaten), પ.ચ. (I will have been eating)

title: Time Expressions — Signal Words for Each Tense
title_hi: समय के संकेत शब्द — प्रत्येक काल के लिए
body:
Simple Present: always, usually, often, never, every day
Present Continuous: now, at this moment, currently, look!
Present Perfect: already, yet, just, ever, never, recently
Simple Past: yesterday, ago, last week, in 2010, when
Past Perfect: before, after, by the time, already (in past)
Simple Future: tomorrow, next week, soon, in future
body_hi:
सरल वर्तमान: हमेशा, आमतौर पर, अक्सर, कभी नहीं, हर दिन
वर्तमान सतत: अभी, इस समय, वर्तमान में
प्रेजेंट परफेक्ट: पहले से, अभी तक, अभी-अभी, कभी, हाल ही में
सरल भूत: कल, पहले, पिछले सप्ताह, 2010 में, जब
भूत परफेक्ट: पहले, बाद में, उस समय तक
सरल भविष्य: कल, अगले सप्ताह, जल्द, भविष्य में
body_gu:
સ.વ.: always, usually, every day
વ.ચ.: now, at this moment
પ.વ.: already, just, yet, recently
ભ.સ.: yesterday, ago, last week
ભ.ભ.: before, after, by the time
ભ.ભ.: tomorrow, next week, soon

title: Solved Example 1: Tenses
problem: Identify the tense: 'She had been waiting for two hours when the bus finally arrived.'
problem_hi: काल पहचानें: 'वह दो घंटे से इंतजार कर रही थी जब बस आखिरकार पहुंची।'
problem_gu: ક. .: 'She had been waiting for two hours when the bus finally arrived.'
solution: PAST PERFECT CONTINUOUS. Signal: 'had been + V-ing'. It shows an action that was ongoing in the past BEFORE another past event (bus arriving).
solution_hi: भूतकाल परफेक्ट सतत। संकेत: 'had been + V-ing'। यह एक ऐसी क्रिया दिखाता है जो भूतकाल में एक अन्य भूतकाल की घटना से पहले चल रही थी।
solution_gu: PAST PERFECT CONTINUOUS. Signal: 'had been + V-ing'. .

title: Solved Example 2: Tenses
problem: Fill in: 'By next year, she _____ (complete) her degree.'
problem_hi: भरें: 'अगले साल तक, वह अपनी डिग्री _____ (पूरी करना)।'
problem_gu: ભ.: 'By next year, she _____ (complete) her degree.'
solution: will have completed. Rule: 'By + future time' → Future Perfect Tense (will have + V3) showing an action that will be completed before a future point.
solution_hi: will have completed। नियम: 'By + भविष्य का समय' → भविष्य परफेक्ट काल (will have + V3)
solution_gu: will have completed. Rule: 'By + future time' = Future Perfect.

title: Solved Example 3: Tenses
problem: Correct the error: 'I am knowing the answer.'
problem_hi: त्रुटि सुधारें: 'I am knowing the answer.'
solution: 'I know the answer.' — Stative verbs (know, believe, understand, love, hate, have, want) do NOT use continuous form. Always use Simple Present with them.
solution_hi: 'I know the answer.' — स्थिर क्रियाएं (know, believe, understand, love, hate) सतत रूप का उपयोग नहीं करतीं।
solution_gu: 'I know the answer.' — Stative verbs continuous form .

question: Choose the correct tense: 'She _____ in Mumbai for ten years now.'
question_hi: सही काल चुनें: 'वह अब दस साल से मुंबई में _____ है।'
question_gu: ય. .: 'She _____ in Mumbai for ten years now.'
explanation: 'has been living' = Present Perfect Continuous. Signal word 'for ten years' + 'now' tells us the action started in the past and is STILL continuing right now.
explanation_hi: 'has been living' = प्रेजेंट परफेक्ट कंटीन्यूअस। संकेत शब्द 'for ten years' + 'now' बताता है कि क्रिया अभी भी जारी है।
explanation_gu: 'has been living' = Present Perfect Continuous. Signal: 'for ten years' + 'now'.

question: Which sentence is grammatically CORRECT?
question_hi: कौन सा वाक्य व्याकरणिक रूप से सही है?
options: I have been understand the lesson.
options_hi: I have been understand the lesson.
options_gu: I have been understand the lesson.
explanation: 'understand' is a stative verb. Stative verbs express a state or condition (not an action), so they do NOT use -ing forms: know, understand, believe, love, hate, want, have (possession).
explanation_hi: 'understand' एक स्थिर क्रिया है। स्थिर क्रियाएं अवस्था व्यक्त करती हैं, इसलिए वे -ing रूपों का उपयोग नहीं करतीं।

question:
Board Exam Pattern — Fill in the blank with correct form:
'By the time we reached the station, the train _____ (already/leave).'
question_hi:
बोर्ड परीक्षा पैटर्न — सही रूप से भरें:
'By the time we reached the station, the train _____ (already/leave).'
question_gu: Board Pattern — .: 'By the time we reached..., the train _____ (already/leave).'
explanation: 'had already left' = Past Perfect. Rule: When TWO past actions occur, the EARLIER action uses Past Perfect (had + V3) and the LATER action uses Simple Past. Train leaving happened BEFORE we reached.
explanation_hi: 'had already left' = भूत परफेक्ट। नियम: जब दो भूतकाल की क्रियाएं हों, तो पहले होने वाली क्रिया Past Perfect में होती है।
explanation_gu: 'had already left' = Past Perfect. Rule: 2 past actions — earlier = Past Perfect.

question:
Identify the tense of the underlined verb:
'The children have been playing in the park for three hours.'
question_hi:
रेखांकित क्रिया का काल पहचानें:
'बच्चे तीन घंटे से पार्क में खेल रहे हैं।'
explanation: Present Perfect Continuous: 'have/has + been + V-ing'. Signal: 'for three hours' shows duration from past to now. The action STARTED in the past and IS STILL happening.
explanation_hi: प्रेजेंट परफेक्ट सतत: 'have/has + been + V-ing'। संकेत: 'for three hours' भूतकाल से अब तक की अवधि दिखाता है।
explanation_gu: Present Perfect Continuous: 'have been + V-ing'. Signal: 'for three hours'.

question:
Board Exam — Editing Exercise:
Spot the error and correct it:
'She don't know the answer to the question.'
question_hi:
बोर्ड परीक्षा — संपादन:
त्रुटि खोजें और सुधारें: 'She don't know the answer.'
options: She do not know the answer.
She is not knowing the answer.
options_hi: She do not know the answer.
She is not knowing the answer.
options_gu: She do not know the answer.
She is not knowing the answer.
explanation: 'She doesn't know.' Error: With 3rd person singular (she/he/it), use 'doesn't' NOT 'don't'. Rule: He/She/It + doesn't + V1 (base form).
explanation_hi: 'She doesn't know.' त्रुटि: 3rd person singular (she/he/it) के साथ 'doesn't' उपयोग करें।
explanation_gu: 'She doesn't know.' Error: 3rd person singular = doesn't.
